coverage_meaning: An edge is tested when its finite-path method/API boundary is exercised and complete independent consumer observations pass. This is whole-path numerical coverage, not an internal tensor probe or physical instruction/branch trace.
finite_path_exclusions: fuse_in=False branch: no diagnostic unfused trial
quantized projection branches: FP32 Linear has no scales
cache object None: passing path always owns actual ArraysCache; anchor has None slot values
gated_delta_update use_kernel=False and non-Dk32 geometries: unused
scalar/masked kernel handles: constructed original initializers but never submitted by module
gated_delta_ops repeated-head path and internal state initialization: Hk=Hv, update supplies state
_gated_delta_step_ops scalar gate and mask branch: module produces vector gate and forwards no mask
all ArraysCache methods except actual construction/state/index/prepare/lengths/padding/advance used here
source_recurrent_step: predecessor partial caller seam is not executed
